# CANDIDATE: NAMED_LEVEL_VOLUME_DRY_UP_REVERSAL

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A retest of a significant named level (prior day high/low, weekly high/low, monthly high/low) on markedly decreasing volume signals lack of conviction and a high-probability reversal. This edge exists because volume dry-up indicates weakening participation in the current trend, making the level more likely to hold and reverse.

## Mechanism

Entry: When price comes within 0.1% of a named level and the bar’s volume is <70% of the average volume of the preceding 20 bars, enter opposite to the direction of approach (short if approaching from below, long if approaching from above) at the close of that bar. Stop placed just beyond the named level (2 ticks above for shorts, below for longs). Exit: Chart-stop at the most recent swing point opposite the entry; initial target at 1.5×R, with stop moved to break-even after 1×R is reached. Regime filters: VIX >18, avoid first/last 30 minutes of session, avoid major news releases.
